comment: Runs execute in order. 'hours' is a cap: the run keeps 60 epochs if they fit, otherwise after epoch 1 it switches to Ultralytics 'time' (LR schedule refitted). The queue also respects --deadline/--budget-hours and leaves time for export.

runs.name: allcrops_v1_yolo26s_416_s20261003

runs.name: allcrops_v1_yolo26n_416_s20261003
runs.why: Fast model for weak phones (about 0.17 s on Redmi Note 7).

runs.name: allcrops_v1_yolo26m_416_s20261003
